scope: Pinned upstream fixes adapted to retained libraries, preserving network features
adaptations: SMB 4.0.0 function names differ; reject short/oversized/odd UTF-16 fields and guard null conversions. FILE_ALL_INFO has a 32-bit wire length, corrected from uint16_t.
FS_ATTRIBUTE decoder is absent in SMB 4.0.0; CVE-2026-110713 volume path is patched.
NFS maxsize semantics preserved from upstream 7613236. Backport includes byte length/padding overflow guard absent from older base and zero element-size rejection.
